name: cfcmt-bus-iql-backup-diagnostic-v1
counterfactual: Fixed learner/state/common latent draws; toggle only existing config.backup_entropy for H2O+ TD target computation; no parameter, optimizer, model or policy update.
diagnostics: Actual reward, duration-discounted V and min-target-Q bootstrap, latent entropy target delta, ON/OFF TD residuals and their ratio.
Original per-record IQL advantages/exp-temperature3/clamp100 weights: quantiles, cap/near-zero/exact-zero fractions and ESS/N.
Stratify free and forced execution states; identical physical forced actions do not imply identical latent entropy.
admission: One real seed75101 checkpoint-state batch; single positive draw and identical RNG; check decomposition against actual _target with backup entropy ON/OFF and actual IQL value terms. No policy evaluation or training.
limits: Fixed fit states and learned values; not real counterfactual cost or a performance test of entropy removal.
Monte Carlo8 common latent draws for full diagnostic; admission uses the actual single-draw kernel.
Existing critics are held fixed when entropy is toggled; lower residual is not proof that a new training arm improves outcomes.
code_boundary: CFCMT-owned snapshot only; no mutable Thesis access; JSON/code/log pulls only, no local H5/CSV/checkpoints.
